content: Tsonsi ñajan mar'ye sombo'je'choma atte. Nane dyo'ccoa cocoya, siete tsovepa, diez ontsian'ccove an'bian'cho sombosi gi atte. Tise poi ontsian'cconi tsu cori otifaccuja jin. Tise poi tsovenga Chigama afase'cho egae inisema tevaen'choma gi atte.

Ña atte'cho dyo'ccoa cocoyaja ttesiaca'en tsu ccutsu. Tise tsu'tteja oncomari tsu'tte'ca'on tsu. Tise aya'faja cuvo ttesi aya'fa'ca'on tsu. Nane cocoya na'su canjansija osha'cho va andeni'su jinchombe na'supa tsu dyo'ccoa cocoyama antte na'suve dapa cuintsu osha'choma mandaye. Toya'caen tise oshacho'choma tsu afe.

Tsa dyo'ccoa cocoyaja fae tsove iñaccapa tayo pa'chove attian. Tsa'ma iñacca'cho tayo ccushasi poi ande'su aindeccu bo'yo'e dapa can'boen'fa. Can'boemba Chigave in'janqquia'caen dyo'ccoa cocoyama in'jan'fa.

Dyo'ccoa cocoyama in'jamba canjansinga'qque puntssan ccuipa iñajan'fa. Nane canjansija dyo'ccoa cocoyanga tise manda'choma anttesi tisema iñajan'fa. Toya'caen tsu tsa dyo'ccoa cocoyanga puntssan ccuipa su'fa: —¿Majan tsu dyo'ccoa cocoya'caen mandaye osha'fa? ¿Majan tsu tisei'ccu geraeñe osha'faya?
Tsa'caen cocoya na'su anttesi dyo'ccoa cocoyaja na'suve dapa cuarenta y dos ccovuve manda. Na'suve dapa Chigama afasepa quinsepoemba afa.
Nane Chiga Quitsama afasepa egae afa. Chiga inisema afasepa, Chiga can'jen'choma, tseni can'jensundeccuma'qque afase.

Nane cocoya na'su canjansi anttesi dyo'ccoa cocoyaja Chigambe aindeccui'ccu geraenccopa patsu. Tsa'caen patsusi cocoyaja tise osha'cho'choma tisenga afe cuintsu poi a'ima, nane poi andesundeccuma, poi aya'fa'suma, poi manda'su na'suma'qque mandaye.

Nane poi andeni'su aindeccu tsu tsa dyo'ccoa cocoyama iñajan'fa. Toya andeve meinte Chigaja osha'choma in'jamba canseya'chondeccu tevaen'jema tevaen. Nane Tise'be Oveja pasi tise've in'jamba ccushaya'chondeccuma in'jamba tsa Ovejambe Canseya'chondeccu Tevaen'jenga tise'pa inisema tevaen. Tsa'ma poiyi'cco majambe inisema tseni tevaembi'choa tsu cocoyama iñajan'fa.
Omboe faesu dyo'ccoa cocoya ande'ye sombo ji'choma gi atte. Tiseja oveja'caen tsu dos ontsian'ccove an'bian. Tsa'ma tise aya'faja canjansi cocoya aya'fa'caen afa.

Va omboe ji'cho dyo'ccoa cocoyaja o'tie ji'cho cocoyama shondo'su. Otien'su mandasi omba'suja poi biani'su andeni japa manda. Manda cuintsu poi ande'su aindeccuja otien'su dyo'ccoa cocoyama in'jamba iñajan'faye. Nane paye dyo'oe iñaccapa ccushasi poiyi'cco tisema iñajan'faya'cho.
Omba'su cocoyaja osha'cho agattoen'chove canjaen. Nane tise mandasi tsu si'ngeja sefaccone andenga amppipa oque. Tsa'caen amppisi poiyi'cco aindeccu can'boen ccutsu'fa.

Otien'su cocoya tsa'caen anttepa caña'jensi tsu omba'su cocoyaja agattoen'chove canjaemba aindeccuma afopoen. Afopoemba manda cuintsu ñoña'cho cocoyave ñoñamba ccutsiañe. Nane sundaro matichi'ccu iñaccapa toya canse'cho cocoya'ca'en tsu ñoña'cho cocoyave ñoña'fa cuintsu tsama'qque aindeccu iñajan'faye.
Ti'tsse anttesi omba'su cocoyaja ñoña'cho cocoyama qquendyaen cuintsu cansepa afaye. Afapa ñoña'choja majan aindeccu tisema iñajan'fambian'da poiyi'cco tsendeccuma fi'ttiye manda.

Toya'caen tsu poiyi'ccoma manda, majan ti'tsse'tssia, majan utu'ccoa, majan rico, majan pori, majan na'su mechoa, majan nasu'pa, nane poiyi'ccoma tsu manda cuintsu tise'pa tansinfa'su tivenga, tsambi'ta tise'pa tsovejunga tevaenge'faye.
Tsa'caen tevaenge'fambi'ta ni chavaye ni chavaeñe osha'faya'bi. Tsa tevaen'cho tsu otien'su cocoya inise. Tsambi'ta tise inisema agatto'cho tsu.
Vama ñotsse in'jamba in'jan'faja. Majan injama'pata tsu agatto'choma ñotsse in'jaña'cho. Tsa agatto'cho tsu seisciento sesenta y seis, a'i inisema agatto'cho.
